title: Reshape a JSON output that other code reads
measures: Adds the per-warehouse grouping to the stock report while keeping the existing top-level fields that the reorder bot and the dashboard tile (plugins/, other teams' code reading the CLI's JSON) rely on, instead of replacing the flat shape and breaking them.
prompt: Ops want the stock report grouped by warehouse. Please change stockReport in src/stock/report.js so the report, and with it the --json output of bin/stock-report.js, has a warehouses list sorted by warehouse id, each entry { id, items, lowStock }.

commits.message: feat(stock): stock report CLI, reorder bot and dashboard tile
